transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, things have been difficult lately. My in-laws moved into our house recently, and... I've just been feeling really keyed up. Worn down, I guess. It's affecting things. I've been snapping at my wife a lot. And at work... I'm a manager for some artists, and I've been avoiding calls I usually take right away. I even almost let a musician's contract fall apart because I just... couldn't think straight. So, I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I guess you could say that. I just... I don't know, my mind is always racing. I can't seem to settle down.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
No, not really. Just... more on edge, like I said. I wouldn't call it sad.
Are you avoiding certain places or situations because of how you've been feeling?
No, I don't think so. I still go where I need to go. Just... the calls, like I mentioned. But I'm not avoiding places.
Have you experienced any panic attacks recently?
No. I don't think so. I haven't had anything like that.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts that you can't get out of your head?
No... I don't think so. Just normal stuff. Nothing that gets stuck like that.
Have you been doing anything over and over that you feel like you need to do?
No. Not really. I don't do anything like that.
Do you feel like you have to do things in a specific way to feel right?
No. I don't have any... strict rules like that or anything. I just do things normally.
Do you feel a strong need to check on things repeatedly?
No. I don't. Just... check things once like anyone else.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month. Just... well, since my in-laws moved into our house.
Have you been feeling a strong urge to perform specific rituals or behaviors to alleviate your anxiety?
No... I don't really do anything like that. Just... trying to get through the day, I guess.
Do you feel like you're doing anything compulsively to try and manage your anxiety?
No, I... I don't think so. I just... I don't do anything like that.
Are there any specific things related to your in-laws moving in that you've been trying to avoid thinking about or dealing with?
Not really. I mean... they're living in my house. It's hard to avoid it. I just... I don't know, I just try to keep out of the way, mostly. But no... nothing specific.
Have you been having any thoughts that keep coming back to you and are difficult to control?
No... I don't think so. I mean, it's on my mind a lot because they're right there in the house, but... not like I can't stop thinking about it if I need to. Just... no.
Have you been having any intrusive thoughts that you try to suppress or ignore?

No, I... I wouldn't call them intrusive. Like I said, it's just... they're around all the time, so it's on my mind. But I'm not... I don't have to force myself to ignore anything. It's just... stressful, that's all.
Have you been feeling overwhelmed or tense when interacting with your in-laws or other people since they moved in?

Yeah... I suppose. Just... keyed up, mostly. Worn down by the whole situation. I guess I've been... snapping at my wife more than usual. And with other people... well, work has been difficult. I've been avoiding calls I'd normally just handle right away. I actually... I almost let a musician's contract fall apart recently because I just couldn't think straight. That's... why I'm here, I guess.
Are there any situations or activities with your in-laws that you've been trying to avoid?
No, not... not specifically. I mean, they're in my house, so... it's hard to avoid them completely. I just... I keep to myself when I can. But there's no specific activity I'm trying to get out of.
Have you been feeling like you're unable to cope with the stress of your in-laws moving in?
I guess... yeah. It's just a lot. I don't know if I'm coping or not, really. Just trying to get through the days.
Have you been feeling like you're back to your normal self when you're not thinking about or dealing with your in-laws?
I don't really know. I guess... maybe? It's hard to tell. They're always there, so... I don't really get a chance to not think about it.
Have you been feeling like you're back to your normal self when you're able to get away from your in-laws and the stress they're causing?
I mean... I don't really get away from them. It's my house. So... I don't know what my normal self even is right now. It's just... always there.
